title: Mark friendly units, positions, routes and areas
breadcrumb: Mark friendly units, positions, routes and areas

slides.title: Pick the unit
slides.html: Tap Markers, Friendly, the symbol and › on your platoon, here 1J, to list its squads. Tap your squad, here 2R, or Other type or search… for a friendly type that is not in your ORBAT.

slides.title: Mark the squad
slides.html: Unit says whose mark it is and Owner who keeps it up to date. Tap Place, then the map.

slides.title: Pick a position
slides.html: Open Markers, tap Friendly and Position, and check that Unit reads your squad. Fighting position comes first, with Firing area On, so tap Place.

slides.title: Draw its front
slides.html: Tap its left end, then its right end, facing the enemy. Tap Done.

slides.title: Set the firing area
slides.html: Drag L, R and the range, then tap Done, or Skip for none. Green shows what the position can see.

slides.title: Mark the Y-point
slides.html: Tap where the squad gathers before moving in, or Cancel to skip it.

slides.title: Draw a direction of attack
slides.html: Open Markers, tap Friendly, Route, the symbol, Direction of attack and Place. Draw it from start to tip and tap Done, then mark an Objective the same way from Area, drawing its outline at the tip.

slides.title: Check the map
slides.html: Short names tell them apart: TULIALUE AS the firing area of a fighting position, Y a Y-point, HS a direction of attack, OBJ an objective. Hide sight clears the green.
